## What does this change?
<!-- One or two sentences. -->

## Type
- [ ] feat – new feature
- [ ] fix – bug fix
- [ ] chore / docs / refactor / test

## Checklist
- [ ] CI is green (lint + migrations + smoke test)
- [ ] Database change? → a new file in `database/migrations/` (never edit an old one)
- [ ] No passwords, tokens or `.env` in the code
- [ ] Tested on staging before merging to `main`
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (for releases)
